# Phase 1
1. <Picture 1> Amy is at home on a normal day, wearing a tight black tank top and denim jeans, cooking breakfast for her young kids Will and Amber.

2. <Picture 1> Amy looks up as a zombie smashes through the kitchen door window and she sees the danger.
# Phase 3
3. <Picture 1> Amy rushes Will and Amber to the basement, gets them inside, locks the door, retrieves her hidden pistol and katana from a floor safe near the stairs, and equips both weapons.
# Phase 4
4. <Picture 1> Amy wields her katana and pistol to kill a group of zombies as they try and attack her.
# Phase 5
5. <Picture 1> Amy swings her katana and fires her pistol to kill another group of zombies as they try and attack her.
# Phase 6
6. <Picture 1> Amy swings her katana and fires her pistol to kill a third group of zombies as they try and attack her.
# Phase 7
7. <Picture 1> Amy swings her katana and fires her pistol to kill a fourth group of zombies as they try and attack her.
# Phase 8
8. <Picture 1> Amy kills the last zombie with her katana and pistol as blood soaks into her clothes; then she unlocks the basement door, letting Will and Amber out.
